newsitem.title: CHINA: Shanghai to hold 200 events to mark Hong Kong return.
newsitem.headline: Shanghai to hold 200 events to mark Hong Kong return.

text.p: China's biggest city of Shanghai is holding more than 200 official events this month to celebrate the return of the British colony of Hong Kong to Chinese rule at midnight on June 30, officials said on Monday.
"From June 1 to July 1, Shanghai will be holding more than 200 activities," Jiao Yang, deputy director of the Information Office of Shanghai Municipality, told a news briefing.

The events range from television shows aimed at educating the booming city of 17 million people about Hong Kong's laws, society and way of life, to plays and singing performances about the territory, Jiao said.
"Patriotic education will be an important part," she said of the celebrations to mark Hong Kong's handover after 156 years of British colonial rule.

The festivities will culminate on July 1 with a gathering of city officials and business leaders at the foot of Shanghai's landmark, the Oriental Pearl television tower, in a ceremony that may feature a fireworks display, she said.
